title: WPSS/1364/2007 of SMT. KALAWATI PANTHRI Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
W.P. No. 1364 of 2007 (S/S)
With
Stay App. Nil / 07
Hon'ble. P.C. Pant, J.
 Heard learned counsel for the
petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for
the respondents.
 By means of this writ petition, the
petitioner has challenged order dated
05.09.2007, whereby her transfer from
Government Girls Inter College, Uttarkashi
to Government Inter College, Sabhawala,
Dehradun, is cancelled.
 The impugned order appears to have
been passed in pursuance to the Government
Order No. 357 / XXIV -2 / 2007 dated 13th
August 2007. By said Government Order,
the State Government has reflected a policy
that the posts of the Lectures / Teachers of
the Inter Colleges and Schools in the interior
/ remote areas be not be left vacant. With that
object the transfer from 'Durgam' to
'Sugam' and from 'Sugam' to 'Sugam' are
directed to be cancelled. The petitioner's
transfer was from 'Sugam' to 'Sugam'.
 This Court cannot interfere with the
policy decision of the State Government, nor
can it be said to have no rationale or no
nexus with the object of the Government
Order.
 The transfer order does not appear to
have been made due to the malice on the
part of the authorities. Neither there is any
arbitrariness in the transfer order, nor it
appears to be against the rules.
 In the above circumstances, the writ
petition is dismissed, in limine, with the
observation that if the petitioner makes a
representation within ten days from today to
the authorities concerned, such authorities
may consider the representation of the
petitioner.
 (Stay Application also stands
dismissed, accordingly)
(P.C. P., J.)
 21.09.2007
